narrationScript: Welcome to Cohortia's CS50 journey! In this first chapter, we're diving into the fundamental questions: What exactly is computer science, and how do computers fundamentally 'think'? By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to define computer science as a distinct field and understand how it differs from just programming. You'll learn the very basic language computers speak: the binary system, and even practice converting binary numbers to decimal and back. We'll explore the essential hardware components that make up any computer, from your phone to a supercomputer. And finally, you'll grasp the crucial concept of an algorithm, which is the precise set of instructions computers follow to solve any problem.
